repos.description: 收集全网 Android TV电视盒子应用，涵盖影视、直播、K歌、工具、游戏等类型，整理优质APK资源，支持便捷下载与自动更新。提供安全验证、分类索引与兼容性标注，助力用户打造家庭影音娱乐中心！              ✅ TVBox/影视仓等影音壳接口配置源。
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库收集全网 Android TV 电视盒子应用，涵盖影视、直播、K歌、工具、游戏等类型，整理优质 APK 资源，支持便捷下载与自动更新。提供安全验证、分类索引与兼容性标注，助力用户打造家庭影音娱乐中心。同时提供 TVBox/影视仓等影音壳接口配置源，方便快速搭建个性化影音系统。
repos.summary_en: This repository collects a wide range of Android TV box apps, covering movies, live TV, karaoke, tools, and games. It provides high-quality APK resources with convenient download and auto-update features, along with security verification, category indexing, and compatibility notes. It also offers interface configuration sources for TVBox and similar apps, helping users build a home entertainment center.

repos.summary_zh: Sandboxie Plus & Classic 是针对 Windows 的沙盒隔离工具，通过虚拟化技术创建安全环境，隔离运行不可信程序，防止对系统驱动器和注册表的永久修改。它具备快照管理和便携模式，适用于软件测试、隐私保护和安全防护。
repos.summary_en: Sandboxie Plus & Classic stands as a premier sandbox-based isolation software suite designed for modern Windows operating systems. By creating a highly secure, virtualized operating environment, it allows users to run untrusted applications and perform web browsing without leaving traces or making permanent modifications to local drives, mapped directories, or the system registry.

repos.description: The best IP Toolbox. Check your IP address & geolocation, test IP for WebRTC and DNS IP leaks, run an IP quality check, browser fingerprint check, website availability check, network speed test, global latency test, MTR test, Whois search, and more.
repos.summary_zh: MyIP是一个开源、支持Docker一键自部署的全能IP工具箱，集成多源IP查询、WebRTC与DNS泄露检测、浏览器指纹分析、全球网速与延迟测试、MTR路由追踪及Whois查询。结合PWA技术支持，旨在为用户提供一站式网络隐私保护、连接质量诊断与基础设施深度探测解决方案。
repos.summary_en: MyIP is an open-source, all-in-one IP toolbox designed for comprehensive network diagnostics and privacy protection. Self-hostable via a single Docker command and supported as a PWA, it integrates multi-source IP lookup, WebRTC & DNS leak detection, browser fingerprinting, global speed and latency tests, MTR, and Whois queries. It provides users with an all-in-one solution for security assessment and infrastructure exploration.

repos.description: 致力于成为中文区命中率最高的广告过滤列表，实现精确的广告屏蔽和隐私保护。anti-AD 现已支持 AdGuardHome，dnsmasq，Surge，Pi-Hole，Clash, mihomo，smartdns，sing-box 等网络组件。完全兼容常见的广告过滤工具所支持的各种广告过滤列表格式
repos.summary_zh: anti-AD 是专注于中文区的高命中率广告过滤与隐私保护列表，通过合并、优化主流 hosts 及 adblock 规则并剔除失效域名，实现 DNS 层面的精准屏蔽。全面兼容 AdGuardHome、Clash、Surge、sing-box 等主流网络组件，有效拦截电视盒子、App 内置广告及隐私追踪站点，守护个人隐私。
repos.summary_en: anti-AD is a high-hit-rate ad filtering and privacy protection list tailored for the Chinese region. By merging and optimizing mainstream hosts and adblock rules while removing dead domains, it achieves precise blocking at the DNS layer. Fully compatible with AdGuardHome, Clash, Surge, and sing-box, it effectively blocks TV box ads, in-app ads, and privacy trackers.

repos.description: deadpool代理池工具，可从hunter、quake、fofa等网络空间测绘平台取高质量socks5代理，或本地导入socks5代理，轮询使用代理进行流量转发。
repos.summary_zh: Deadpool是一款基于Go语言的代理池工具，专为网络安全测试设计。它能从Hunter、Quake、Fofa等网络空间测绘平台自动获取高质量SOCKS5代理，或从本地文件导入代理，通过健康检查与去重机制构建稳定代理池。工具提供本地SOCKS5监听端口，支持流量转发与IP轮换，有效解决渗透测试中IP封禁问题。具备统计信息展示、优雅关闭、周期性任务及账号认证等特性，提升代理管理效率与安全性。
repos.summary_en: Deadpool is a Go-based proxy pool tool designed for cybersecurity testing. It automatically harvests high-quality SOCKS5 proxies from cyber space platforms like Hunter, Quake, and Fofa, or imports them locally. With health checks and deduplication, it maintains a reliable proxy pool and offers a local SOCKS5 listener for traffic forwarding and IP rotation, mitigating IP bans during penetration testing. Features include statistics display, graceful shutdown, periodic tasks, and authentication, enhancing proxy management efficiency and security.
